arStrings.szText: "To the mages of Yshari Sanctum, I implore you: send any expert in creatures from the Domain of Greed! Be assured, I am no warlock...merely the heir to the Lycandri fortune, foolish enough to think he could guard it with wizardry.
In haste, desperate, but maintaining decorum
Whatever mage rids me of these ghastly mimics, I shall line his dowdy robes in gold!" -On my honor, Gerato Lycandri IX
In haste, desperate, but maintaining decorum
